meta.scope: Indonesia Batch 14 — Natural disaster / volcano / earthquake risk and management. BNPB institutional role, disaster occurrence and impact statistics, Disaster Risk Index, subnational BPBD system, and policy framing across regions.

candidates.title: BNPB – National Disaster Management Authority
candidates.description: National focal point for disaster management, directly under the President. Coordinates risk reduction, preparedness, response and recovery. Publishes the integrated disaster data portal and the Indonesian Disaster Risk Index.
referenced_by: All disaster occurrence, risk-index and subnational BPBD series
candidates.notes: Institutional core of the disaster-management system.

candidates.title: Disaster occurrence and impact statistics (by type and year)
candidates.description: Compiled statistics on the number and impact of disasters by type (floods, landslides, earthquakes, tsunamis, volcanic eruptions, drought, extreme weather, coastal erosion, forest/peat fires, etc.) over multi-year periods.
candidates.notes: Core empirical series for Indonesia’s high multi-hazard exposure.

candidates.title: Indonesian Disaster Risk Index (IRBI)
candidates.description: Composite index assessing disaster risk at provincial and district/city levels across major hazards. Used to prioritise Special Allocation Funds for disaster management and to guide local risk-reduction strategies.
candidates.notes: Key spatial risk node that makes inter-regional differences in hazard exposure statistically explicit.

candidates.title: Provincial and local Disaster Management Agencies (BPBD)
candidates.description: Subnational disaster-management agencies that implement risk reduction, preparedness and response at provincial and local levels. Coverage has expanded to nearly all provinces.
referenced_by: Disaster Risk Index and occurrence statistics
candidates.notes: Subnational institutional densification of the disaster system.

candidates.title: Volcanic and earthquake / tsunami hazard and event statistics
candidates.region: Especially Ring of Fire zones (Java, Sumatra, Sulawesi, eastern islands)
candidates.description: Statistics and monitoring products focused on volcanic eruptions, earthquakes and tsunamis — the high-impact geophysical hazards that define much of Indonesia’s risk profile and have driven major policy redesigns (e.g. post-Palu tsunami warning improvements).
candidates.notes: Geophysical-hazard densification. Indonesia sits on the Pacific Ring of Fire.

candidates.title: National disaster-management policy and legal framework
candidates.description: Legal and policy instruments governing disaster management (including the post-2004 institutional redesign that created BNPB and the subsequent risk-reduction strategies). Recurring citation in resilience and development planning.
referenced_by: BNPB, BPBD and Risk Index nodes
candidates.notes: Policy-frame node for the entire disaster cluster.

candidates.title: Indonesia disaster-risk and management meta-node
candidates.publisher: Derived from BNPB and related sources
candidates.description: Meta-node binding BNPB, disaster occurrence/impact statistics, Disaster Risk Index, BPBD subnational system, volcano/earthquake/tsunami focus, and the national policy framework into a coherent multi-hazard resilience layer with explicit inter-regional variation.
referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
Earlier environmental, provincial and climate series
candidates.notes: Integrating node for the disaster round.
